lessons: Completion is high at midday (12:00-14:00) with psychological capability and physical opportunity, and in afternoons/evenings; mornings and outdoor-context slots were skipped more often. Heavy days still work, so load is not discriminating. I place standalone tasks in midday windows on weekdays, keep intensity-2 walks at midday, anchor alongside tasks to lunch or routines, and avoid weekends and low-opportunity late evenings.
